objective: Build ci/locked-tools: tools run from the lockfile, claude-code locked, version script updates bun.lock.
scope: Worktree worktree c, branch release/0.2.0/ci/locked-tools, based on release/0.2.0/ci/validate-and-guard (PR #18).
constraints: No new tool that overlaps the toolchain; AGENTS.md unchanged; README.md is not yours (report any README line that would need changing instead of editing it).
acceptance_criteria: Before switching, show that `bun run oxfmt --check` and `bun run oxlint` (or the exact bun run form) resolve the locked node_modules binaries on Bun 1.4.3, and that they fail loudly when node_modules is absent instead of fetching.
mise.toml format and lint tasks (and any CI step) use that form; no bunx remains for oxfmt or oxlint.

claude-code: in a clean copy, add @anthropic-ai/claude-code at exact 2.1.300 as a root devDependency, install with --frozen-lockfile on Bun 1.4.3 without lifecycle scripts, and run `plugin validate --strict plugin` and `.` from the installed binary. If that works, CI runs it that way; if not, create a CI-only package (own package.json and bun.lock, outside the workspaces) and CI installs it frozen and runs it from there. Report which and why.

scripts/bump-version.ts also updates the workspace version entries in bun.lock; a test asserts the bun.lock workspace versions equal the manifests' versions, and the bump script's test covers the lockfile update.
fmt, lint, typecheck and full test pass; bun install --frozen-lockfile passes.
result: C built: mise fmt/lint via bun run (locked binaries, fail loudly without install); claude-code 2.1.300 exact root devDependency, frozen install without lifecycle scripts, validate passes from bun run claude; bump-version updates bun.lock workspace versions with lockfile.test.ts and 3 bump tests. Gates pass (1147 tests). README 347/353-354 need a bun.lock mention (not owned).

acceptance.rationale: Writer report verified by independent review a867 (no blockers); README drift handled in a follow-up.

required_evidence.claude-code-decision: root exact devDependency; frozen install and validate verified
